records.title: Innovative tooth segmentation using hierarchical features and bidirectional sequence modeling
records.reason: The paper proposes a tooth-segmentation model using hierarchical features and bidirectional sequence modeling. It does not concern LLM inference/serving.

records.title: Training Versatile Coding Agents in Synthetic Environments
records.reason: Training Versatile Coding Agents in Synthetic Environments develops agent training tasks and capability evaluations, not inference optimization.

records.title: UltraImage: Rethinking Resolution Extrapolation in Image Diffusion Transformers
records.reason: UltraImage studies resolution extrapolation in image diffusion transformers. It is a generative vision quality/generalization method, not LLM inference efficiency.

records.title: Masked Diffusion for Generative Recommendation
records.reason: Masked Diffusion for Generative Recommendation applies discrete diffusion to recommendation outputs. Parallel generation is a possible inference lead, but primary evaluation is recommender quality rather than general LLM efficiency.

records.title: Percept-WAM: Perception-Enhanced World-Awareness-Action Model for Robust End-to-End Autonomous Driving
records.reason: Percept-WAM is a perception-enhanced world-action model for autonomous driving. It focuses on driving capability and robustness; a cited cached-knowledge serving paper does not establish an efficiency contribution here.
